name: Operation Recombobulation
summary: In Kharanos, Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt seek a cure for their kin. After Gnomeregan's fall, they hope an experimental machine can reverse the change that made many gnomes leper gnomes.

sections.title: A Remedy for a Calamity
sections.body: Radiation meant to purge the troggs in Gnomeregan changed most of the city's gnomes into sickly, deranged leper gnomes instead. Razzle Sprysprocket refuses to accept that this change must last. Working with Ozzie Togglevolt, the inventor is building a machine called the Recombobulator to restore their afflicted kin to health and sanity.

sections.title: Scavenging from the Afflicted
sections.body: Razzle needs Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears to build a delicate prototype. The parts come from the hostile leper gnomes outside Gnomeregan's sealed gates. Razzle hopes the debris taken from their altered kin will help build a device to undo the tragedy they share.

faq.q: What is the Recombobulator supposed to do?
faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt designed the Recombobulator to reverse the effects of Gnomeregan's radiation and cure leper gnomes.

faq.q: Who are Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie?
faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt are gnomish inventors working in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh. Since Gnomeregan fell, they have devoted their skills to finding ways to save their displaced, irradiated people.

faq.q: Why are there leper gnomes outside Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Radiation released during the trogg invasion failed to kill the troggs and instead drove many surviving gnomes mad, changing them into hostile leper gnomes.

faq.q: Where do the parts for the Recombobulator come from?
aliases: where to get cogs and gears
faq.answer: The parts come from leper gnomes outside Gnomeregan's entrance in western Dun Morogh. The afflicted gnomes still carry salvaged mechanical hardware on their bodies.

Razzle says the right parts, hydrolubricant, and adjustments to the electrogum gel will restore the gnomes to normal. Gnomish engineering can be volatile, and it remains uncertain whether the machine can undo toxic irradiation.

angles.text: For gnomes, this work offers a desperate hope of saving family and friends, changed into violent shells during the fall of their capital.
As an engineer, you can appreciate Razzle's unorthodox work with Restabilization Cogs, crank-o-ratchets, and viscous electrogum gel to manipulate biophysical radiation.
